## Hotfix
- R8 obfuscation causing Vulkan detection crash (by @MovTery)


## Updates:
- GP#1805: Added two-finger swipe scroll gesture in-game (by @MovTery)
- GP#1811: Check and mark mods already installed for the current version on the mod download page (by @MovTery)
- GP#1824: Added support for custom game resolution (by @MovTery)
- GP#1821: Added support for using the Narrator in-game (by @MovTery)
- GP#1827: File manager entries now use MD3E cards and colored circular icons (by @MovTery)
- GP#1829: Foreground keep-alive for tasks to prevent interruption when switched to background (by @MovTery)
- GP#1830: Added support for selecting and installing dependency projects when downloading resources (by @MovTery)
- GP#1838: Display resource type badges in project details on the right side of the resource download screen (by @MovTery)

## Refactors:
- GP#1819: Refactored Vulkan detection, annotate dependencies by Minecraft version range (by @MovTery)

## Changes:
- GP#1830: On the resource download page, dependency project info is now cached asynchronously in the background (by @MovTery)
- GP#1833: Version management top action bar adjusted to semi-transparent when custom background content is set (by @MovTery)

## Fixes:
- GP#1803: Corrected renderer version compatibility (by @Xirren)
- GP#1804: Save playtime formatting not correctly decomposed into non-overlapping components (by @MovTery)
- GP#1810: Removed frame rate lock to screen refresh rate (by @MovTery)
- GP#1822: Floating ball position becomes off-screen and invisible after window size changes (by @MovTery)
- GP#1844: Window size not refreshing properly when switching launcher to background (by @MovTery)
- GP#1849: Terracotta multiplayer VPN service not entering foreground in time causing game process crash
- GP#1850: SDL input method routed by render path, fixed inability to invoke soft keyboard in Controlify environment (by @MovTery)
